name: beget-s3-mcp-ai-cli
description: Beget S3 MCP server and AI CLI with scoped access and signed human approvals.

access_key_id.title: Access key ID
access_key_id.description: S3 access key ID. Required. The desktop host stores it as a secret and passes it only to this server.

secret_access_key.title: Secret access key
secret_access_key.description: S3 secret access key. Required. The desktop host stores it as a secret and passes it only to this server.

pool.title: Pool
pool.description: Signing pool. The default is this provider's usual pool. An empty value is not left empty: the desktop host fills in that default.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: Optional S3 endpoint override. Empty uses the endpoint of the selected pool.

allowed_buckets.title: Allowed buckets
allowed_buckets.description: Comma-separated bucket allowlist. Empty does not add a bucket allowlist.

allowed_prefixes.title: Allowed prefixes
allowed_prefixes.description: Comma-separated bucket/prefix/ allowlist. Empty does not add a prefix allowlist.

destructive_policy.title: Destructive policy
destructive_policy.description: How a destructive call asks for a person. Default confirm asks before each one. Empty is treated as confirm.

file_root.title: File root
file_root.description: Directory for local upload and download. Empty disables confined file transfer.

allow_write.title: Allow write
allow_write.description: Register write tools. Off leaves write disabled. With write, delete and admin all off, the server is read-only.

allow_delete.title: Allow delete
allow_delete.description: Register delete tools. Off leaves delete disabled. With write, delete and admin all off, the server is read-only.

allow_admin.title: Allow admin
allow_admin.description: Register admin tools. Off leaves bucket administration disabled. With write, delete and admin all off, the server is read-only.
